from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = n // 2
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(center + 1):
        out[r][center - r] = 2
        out[r][center + r] = 2
    for r in range(3, n):
        for c in range(n):
            if abs(c - center) <= r - 2 and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-56b785ea.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'))
